digest.component_or_area: authorship fixture / batched ticket position commit mapping
propositions: The test fixture's equivalence assertion treated a raw optimization helper as guaranteed to succeed on first attempt, but the helper explicitly fails closed to empty dict on transient Git failures (rc nonzero, empty output, or process exception).

Injecting rc 128/empty, rc 0/empty, and BlockingIOError(EAGAIN) at the batched git-log boundary reproduces the observed sequence: first call returns empty dict, immediate identical replay returns all 8 position-to-SHA pairs from the unchanged repository.

The _fixture_batched_map recovery helper performs at most five exact resolver attempts, returns on first complete map, and raises with fsck/count-objects diagnostics after persistent failure, without changing production authorship source or fallback semantics.

Deleting the previously implicated loose object 66842fd0 left both broad git log (rc 0, 804-byte output) and narrow per-event reads healthy, proving this batched-empty/narrow-success recurrence is not the earlier missing-loose-blob ENOENT class.
